productName: VoltGrid SCADA Substation & High-Voltage Transmission Monitor
targetAudience: Electrical grid engineers and substation safety officers monitoring 150kV transformers
operationalContext: Mission-critical control room, high stress during grid faults, zero room for ambiguous visual states
dataVisualizationNeeds: Real-time voltage/current sinewaves, transformer thermal heatmaps, multi-feeder breaker trip states

concepts.identityRationale: Ultra-focused, high-contrast dark industrial console adhering to IEC 60870-5 and ISA-101 high-performance HMI standards. Uses muted neutral surfaces with high-visibility safety color coding exclusively for operational anomalies.

layout.columnGrid: Rigid 16-column grid with persistent top-level alarm banner and 4-quadrant busbar matrix
layout.focalPoint: Substation breaker single-line diagram and alarm queue

surface.elevationModel: Flat border-first architecture (1px solid #334155), zero decorative drop shadows

iconography.style: Standardized ISA-101 industrial electrical schematic symbols
iconography.geometry: Strictly geometric angles for circuit breakers and transformers

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (15.8:1 white on dark slate)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Complies with ISO 11064 ergonomic requirements for control room display stations

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Absolute visual clarity; zero ambiguity during electrical emergency triages
uxTradeoffs.risks: Requires professional engineering certification to interpret symbol topology
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: 100% compliant with high-performance HMI guidelines for electrical dispatchers

concepts.identityRationale: High-contrast daylight slate interface engineered for rugged tablets deployed in outdoor substations and field repair trucks. Emphasizes oversized touch targets and extreme outdoor readability.

layout.columnGrid: Chunked 6-column modular card layout for rapid glove-friendly tapping
layout.focalPoint: Selected feeder circuit safety lock and isolator switch status

surface.elevationModel: Deep structural boundaries with 2px borders (#94A3B8) and tactile pressed states

iconography.style: Heavy-stroke industrial tactile icons with filled active states
iconography.geometry: Bold high-visibility contours visible in direct sun glare

primaryCharts: Analog dial gauge with danger threshold markings
dataVisualization.telemetryDensity: Filtered operational states with focus on breaker physical position

accessibility.wcagLevel: WCAG 2.2 AAA text contrast (18.2:1 dark on pure white)
accessibility.ambientLightNotes: Guarantees full sunlight readability (>5000 nits tablet screens)

uxTradeoffs.strengths: Extreme readability in harsh field lighting; glove-compatible interaction
uxTradeoffs.risks: Fewer simultaneous data streams visible per screen
uxTradeoffs.operationalFit: Best for field technicians inspecting switchyards and circuit breakers
